text:
anita: quick workshop dump — want to align on long-term routing policy + multi-region tenant isolation tradeoffs. high level: customers want predictable latency + data controls; infra team needs clear launch gates. who can help sketch launch criteria?

tom: i'm on. can we surface concrete SLAs per slice (hosted vs dedicated)? also need latency budgets per region and per route.

kevin: agree. from infra POV the big knobs are: replication factor, egress allowances, and slice sizing. rough cost note: cross-region replication ~1.9x cost for steady qps.

olivia: pulling customer asks — Acme + FinCo are asking for: (1) region pinning, (2) audit logs + KMS in-region, (3) <200ms median for chat across EU-US pair. they're willing to pay for dedicated slices.

anita: suggested minimal launch criteria (proposal):
- spec: routing policy DSL + op semantics (failover, affinity, quarantine)
- perf: documented latency budgets (p50/p95/p99) per route
- capacity: validated capacity plan + autoscale playbook
- reliability: canary for 72h w/ synthetic traffic, 7d GA observation w/ no sev1s
- security/compliance: region-residency proof + KMS integration tested
- runbooks: evacuation + soft-evict steps + cost-control knobs

tom: small follow-up — define p99 targets separately for hosted vs dedicated. e.g.: hosted chat p99 <= 600ms, dedicated p99 <= 250ms. we should also include tail-latency acceleration (kv-cache warmers).

kevin: adding cost acceptance criteria: target unit-cost increase <= 1.4x baseline for customers who opt into cross-region isolation. otherwise define premium multiplier. i'll model three scenarios by EOD Fri.

olivia: rollout plan idea: sandbox (internal) -> pilot (1-2 customers on dedicated slices) -> open beta (small fleet) -> GA. gating for each stage:
- sandbox -> pilot: telemetry hooks + synthetic canary green 48h
- pilot -> beta: two customers for 7d, no regression on quality/latency >5%
- beta -> GA: stability 14d, documented rollback, capacity runbook signed off

anita: runbook items to include in acceptance tests:
- simulated region outage and automated fallback within policy
- tenant quarantine latency impact <= 15% on unaffected tenants
- billing > sanity check for cross-region egress accounting

kevin: sample Routing DSL stub for discussion:
```
route_policy {
  affinity: region(eu-west-1)
  fallback: region(us-east-1) if latency>500ms
  quarantine: soft-evict(percent=10, cooloff=10m)
  data_residency: must_remain_in(region)
}
```

tom: +1. we should add an explicit "cost-control" stanza so SREs can throttle non-critical traffic under pressure. e.g.: `cost_control: {burst_budget: 1000, throttle_policy: degrade_to_smaller_model}`

olivia: i'll consolidate customer asks and map to the proposed criteria. ANITA — can you own the launch checklist doc and append the gating matrix?

anita: yep i'll draft the checklist and initial gating matrix by Tue. owner assignments: tom -> policy DSL spec, kevin -> cost model + infra impact, olivia -> customer map + pilot candidates.

deploy-bot: Created ticket ISSUE-4827: "routing-policy-dsl + launch-checklist" assigned to anita, tom, kevin, olivia

tom: ack. i'll start a PR with spec skeleton and invite eng-sre for reviews. cc @eng-sre

kevin: will add rough numbers to the PR — also include an optional quantized model option to reduce tail cost.

anita: final ask — let's capture acceptance test commands so QA can run them automatically. small example later today. thanks all :thumbsup:
